name: Multi-Interface Access and UI Modularization
description: Expose the shared application through independent MCP, orchestration-tool, CLI, and API access points, document each interface, and modularize the UI assets.

tasks.name: Shared Core and Interface Adapter Architecture
deliverables: Define stable shared application services independent of any transport or user interface
Define interface adapter contracts for configuration, inputs, outputs, errors, and lifecycle
Create separate application access points that reuse the shared core without duplicating business logic
Propagate model-required and provider-unavailable outcomes consistently across interfaces
Add adapter-level contract tests and configuration isolation

tasks.name: Model Context Protocol Server
deliverables: Add a standalone MCP server entry point over the shared application services
Expose supported operations with validated input schemas and structured results
Return actionable protocol errors for missing configuration, unavailable models, and failed operations
Support documented startup, configuration, and shutdown behavior
Add offline protocol and tool-contract tests

tasks.name: Orchestration Tool Adapter
deliverables: Expose the application as a callable tool for orchestration systems through a separate adapter
Define machine-readable capabilities, input/output contracts, and error states
Support cancellation, timeouts, and correlation identifiers where the host protocol permits
Propagate model requirements and external-provider restrictions without silent fallback
Add adapter contract tests and a runnable integration example

tasks.name: Standalone CLI Access Point
deliverables: Provide a dedicated CLI entry point for supported application workflows
Define command, option, configuration, exit-code, and machine-readable output behavior
Report required or unavailable models with actionable messages and non-success exit status
Add command-level tests and examples

tasks.name: HTTP API Access Point
deliverables: Provide a separately startable HTTP API over the shared application services
Define versioned request and response schemas with OpenAPI documentation
Implement input validation, consistent error responses, and configurable authentication and request limits
Return structured model-required/provider-unavailable states without claiming an operation succeeded
Add API contract and endpoint tests

tasks.name: Interface Documentation and Integration Guides
deliverables: Document MCP setup, configuration, available tools, examples, and troubleshooting
Document orchestration adapter contracts, lifecycle, examples, and host integration
Document CLI installation, commands, options, configuration, exit codes, and examples
Document API setup, authentication, endpoint schemas, errors, and runnable examples
Document shared configuration, privacy behavior, and model-required responses across interfaces

tasks.name: UI Asset Separation
deliverables: Separate the existing UI HTML entry document from its stylesheet and browser-side JavaScript
Move inline styles and scripts into dedicated CSS and JavaScript files
Update asset references and verify the UI behavior remains unchanged
Add a smoke check for loading the separated assets
